mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PUSH_DEVICE WHERE USEYN='Y' AND UUID = #{uuid}

SELECT SN, UUID, NTWRK_DEVICE_INFO, OS_VER, DEVICE_NM, USEYN, OS_TYPE, TOKEN_ID FROM PUSH_DEVICE WHERE USEYN='Y' ORDER BY SN DESC
LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PUSH_DEVICE WHERE USEYN='Y'

SELECT MIN(SN) AS SN,
COALESCE(MIN(CASE WHEN UUID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{uuid}, '%') THEN UUID END), MIN(UUID)) AS UUID,
MIN(UUID) AS UUID,
MESSAGE, SND_DT, COUNT(*) AS DEVICE_CNT FROM PUSH_MESSAGE
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PUSH_MESSAGE matched_row WHERE matched_row.MESSAGE = PUSH_MESSAGE.MESSAGE AND matched_row.SND_DT = PUSH_MESSAGE.SND_DT AND (matched_row.UUID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{uuid}, '%') OR matched_row.MESSAGE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{uuid}, '%')) )
GROUP BY MESSAGE, SND_DT ORDER BY CONCAT( LPAD(REGEXP_SUBSTR(SND_DT, '[0-9]+', 1, 1), 4, '0'), LPAD(IFNULL(REGEXP_SUBSTR(SND_DT, '[0-9]+', 1, 2), '0'), 2, '0'), LPAD(IFNULL(REGEXP_SUBSTR(SND_DT, '[0-9]+', 1, 3), '0'), 2, '0'), LPAD(IFNULL(REGEXP_SUBSTR(SND_DT, '[0-9]+', 1, 4), '0'), 2, '0'), LPAD(IFNULL(REGEXP_SUBSTR(SND_DT, '[0-9]+', 1, 5), '0'), 2, '0'), LPAD(IFNULL(REGEXP_SUBSTR(SND_DT, '[0-9]+', 1, 6), '0'), 2, '0'), LPAD(IFNULL(REGEXP_SUBSTR(SND_DT, '[0-9]+', 1, 7), '0'), 3, '0') ) DESC, MIN(SN) DESC
LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT MESSAGE, SND_DT FROM PUSH_MESSAGE
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PUSH_MESSAGE matched_row WHERE matched_row.MESSAGE = PUSH_MESSAGE.MESSAGE AND matched_row.SND_DT = PUSH_MESSAGE.SND_DT AND (matched_row.UUID LIKE CONCAT('%', #{uuid}, '%') OR matched_row.MESSAGE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{uuid}, '%')) )
GROUP BY MESSAGE, SND_DT ) grouped_message
